# RoadVerdict

> RoadVerdict is a free UK vehicle-ownership tracker and quote checker for motorcycle and car owners. Log every service, fill-up, and repair, check whether a garage quote is fair for your vehicle and region, and get a clear buy/negotiate/walk-away verdict before purchasing a used vehicle.

## Tools

- [Quote Checker](https://roadverdict.co.uk/quote-checker): Check whether a service or repair quote is fair for a given vehicle, engine size, and UK region.
- [Buying Guide](https://roadverdict.co.uk/buying-guide): Enter a number plate or paste a listing to get a verdict on whether to buy, negotiate, or walk away, using MOT history and real price data.
- [Cost Calculator](https://roadverdict.co.uk/cost-calculator): Calculate the true running cost per mile, month, and year for a motorcycle or car.

## Vehicle types

- [Cars](https://roadverdict.co.uk/cars): RoadVerdict for car owners.
- [Motorcycles](https://roadverdict.co.uk/motorcycles): RoadVerdict for motorcycle owners.
